readback:
Notation and domains: Let P=ℝ[X], the real polynomial space, X its indeterminate, C(c) the constant polynomial associated with c∈ℝ, and D the formal derivative. Let V=Fin 4→ℝ, with coordinates indexed by 0,1,2,3. Matrix rows and columns use that same order. All spans below are algebraic real-linear spans, consisting of finite linear combinations. Matrix multiplication and matrix-vector multiplication use finite sums over Fin 4; I₄ denotes the identity matrix. The Euclidean vectors below belong to EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), with its real inner product. The exported declarations have no universe parameters or additional implicit hypotheses.

Supplied dependency definitions in SL.AuditRound5: For every x∈ℝ and p∈P, eval_linear(x)(p)=p(x). For every p∈P, write B₊(p)=endpoint_plus(p)=p′(1)−(p(1)−p(−1))/2 and B₋(p)=endpoint_minus(p)=p′(−1)−(p(1)−p(−1))/2. These are real-linear maps. residues(p)=(B₊(p),B₋(p)), and krein_polynomials=ker(residues)={p∈P:B₊(p)=0 and B₋(p)=0}. The definitions p_zero and p_one are 1 and X, respectively.

For every m∈ℕ, let αₘ=(m:ℝ)/((m:ℝ)−1), Eₘ=p_even(m)=X^(2m)−C(αₘ)X^((2m)∸2), and Oₘ=p_odd(m)=X^(2m+1)−C(αₘ)X^((2m)∸1). Here ∸ is natural-number subtraction truncated at zero. The denominator subtraction is real subtraction, and real division is totalized with a/0=0. Thus these definitions include m=0 and m=1: E₀=1, O₀=X, E₁=X² and O₁=X³. The restriction m≥2 occurs in sparse_generators, not in these family definitions.

Definitions in SL.AuditRound6: sparse_generators is G={p∈P:p=1 or p=X or there exists m∈ℕ such that 2≤m and (p=Eₘ or p=Oₘ)}. sparse_span is S=spanℝ(G). augmented_generators is G⁺={p∈P:p∈G or p=X² or p=X³}, and augmented_span is A=spanℝ(G⁺).

four_traces is the real-linear map T:P→V given, for every p∈P, by T(p)=(B₊(p),B₋(p),B₊(D²p),B₋(D²p)). Expanded, its coordinates are p′(1)−(p(1)−p(−1))/2; p′(−1)−(p(1)−p(−1))/2; p‴(1)−(p″(1)−p″(−1))/2; and p‴(−1)−(p″(1)−p″(−1))/2, in that order.

trace_matrix is M=[[2,2,4,4],[-2,2,-4,4],[0,0,24,40],[0,0,-24,40]]. inverse_matrix is N=[[1/4,-1/4,-1/24,1/24],[1/4,1/4,-1/40,-1/40],[0,0,1/48,-1/48],[0,0,1/80,1/80]], with every entry interpreted in ℝ.

monomial_lift is the real-linear map U:V→P defined for every a∈V by U(a)=Σ(i∈Fin 4) a(i)·X^(i.val+2). four_trace_lift is the real-linear map L:V→P defined for every r∈V by L(r)=U(Nr). correct_four_traces is the function Q:P→P defined for every p∈P by Q(p)=p−L(T(p)). cancellation is the fixed polynomial c=E₃−(7/2)·E₂. detector is d=(1,1), witness is w=(1,−1), coordinate_zero is e₀=(1,0), and coordinate_one is e₁=(0,1).

The theorem declarations, with their quantifiers and hypotheses, read as follows:
1. sparse_span_le_krein: S⊆ker(residues).
2. X_sq_not_mem_sparse_span: X²∉S.
3. even_power_mem_augmented: For every m∈ℕ, X^(2m)∈A.
4. odd_power_mem_augmented: For every m∈ℕ, X^(2m+1)∈A.
5. power_mem_augmented: For every n∈ℕ, X^n∈A.
6. polynomial_mem_augmented: For every p∈P, p∈A.
7. augmented_span_eq_top: A=⊤ as submodules of P.
8. four_traces_apply: For every p∈P, T(p)=(residues(p).1,residues(p).2,residues(D²p).1,residues(D²p).2).
9. four_trace_monomial_columns: For every i∈Fin 4, T(X^(i.val+2)) equals the vector j↦M[j,i], with j∈Fin 4.
10. trace_matrix_det: det(M)=15360 in ℝ.
11. trace_matrix_two_sided_inverse: MN=I₄ and NM=I₄.
12. four_traces_monomial_lift: For every a∈V, T(U(a))=Ma.
13. four_trace_right_inverse: For every r∈V, T(L(r))=r.
14. corrected_four_traces_zero: For every p∈P, T(Q(p))=0 in V.
15. correction_fixes_kernel: For every p∈P and every hypothesis h:T(p)=0, Q(p)=p.
16. cancellation_formula: c=X⁶−C(5)X⁴+C(7)X².
17. cancellation_four_traces_zero: T(c)=0 in V.
18. p_four_four_traces: T(E₂)=(0,0,24,−24), where E₂=X⁴−2X².
19. p_four_four_traces_ne_zero: T(E₂)≠0 in V.
20. coordinate_detection_counterexample: ⟨d,e₀⟩=1 and ⟨d,e₁⟩=1 and ⟨d,w⟩=0 and ⟨w,e₀⟩=1 and ⟨w,e₁⟩=−1.
21. local_algebra_root: The following 17 assertions hold jointly: A=⊤; X²∉S; for every i∈Fin 4, T(X^(i.val+2))=(j↦M[j,i]) with j∈Fin 4; det(M)=15360; MN=I₄; NM=I₄; for every r∈V, T(L(r))=r; for every p∈P, T(Q(p))=0; c=X⁶−C(5)X⁴+C(7)X²; T(c)=0; T(E₂)=(0,0,24,−24); T(E₂)≠0; ⟨d,e₀⟩=1; ⟨d,e₁⟩=1; ⟨d,w⟩=0; ⟨w,e₀⟩=1; and ⟨w,e₁⟩=−1.
